scope: sole/only/last/full-service grocery loss or disaster closure
abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.result: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified in the bounded recall window. Fresh surfaced items were non-qualifying: a Kroger expansion in Princeton, Texas; a Save A Lot closure in Watertown, New York without evidence it is the community's sole/last/full-service grocery; and routine scheduled food distribution at F.O.R. Maricopa Food Bank. Other surfaced results were stale or outside the search window.
